description: Untransformed Service to Certain Customers Taking Power from Projects of the New York Power Authority
notes: SC4 rates, terms and conditions are those of the applicable parent service classification (SC3 or SC3A) assigned to the customer for supplemental service, except as modified by SC4 special provisions. SC4 itself does not define distinct charges but references parent classifications for rates. Billing quantities for SC4 Supplemental Service are determined as the difference between total metered demand/energy and the sum of demands/energy from Niagara Power Delivery Service, Preservation Power Delivery Service, HLF Delivery Service, and EDP/PFJ Power under Rule 34. Reactive Demand is defined as highest average RkVA lagging demand minus one-third of highest kW demand. SC4 uses calendar month billing. Loss adjustments and billing quantities for the referenced NYPA power types are detailed in SC4 but actual rates are from parent classifications.
reference: Rates and charges for SC4 Supplemental Service customers are those of the assigned parent service classification (SC3 or SC3A). SC4 itself does not specify standalone charges.

description: Purchase of Electric Energy and Capacity from Customers with Qualifying On-Site Generation Facilities

logic_steps.formula: sum over hours of (Real Time LBMP_i * Q_i) - Incurred Cost
logic_steps.notes: Real Time LBMP in $/MWh; Q_i is energy delivered in kWh per hour; Incurred Cost includes penalties assessed by NYISO
Capacity is Unforced Capacity recognized by NYISO, capped at 5000 kW for contracts executed on or after July 1, 2019
Rate to be paid shall be no less than 6.0 cents per kWh, averaged annually and trued-up monthly
For qualifying small random suppliers without interval metering; customer pays installed cost of metering equipment instead of other charges
Customer Charge under SC6 is required only if customer takes service under SC6 alone; waived if customer also takes service under another classification

Customer Charge and Demand Charge are based on the customer's otherwise applicable service classification for delivery service; if service is taken under both SC6 and another classification through same connection, SC6 Customer Charge is waived and Demand Charge applies only to Buyback Contract Demand in excess of demand billed under other classification

Buyback Contract Demand is customer's contract demand unless a higher maximum demand is recorded, which then becomes the Buyback Contract Demand; reductions allowed only once per 365 days; penalties apply if recorded demand exceeds Buyback Contract Demand by thresholds
